verdict.rationale: Jira is a SaaS product with automation and REST APIs, so the axis of over-limit behavior applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents automation execution limits, API rate limits, or what happens on exceeding them (overage charges, throttling, or a hard stop). The evidence covers only the existence of automation, APIs, a deprecation policy and free signup.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I know what happens—extra charges, throttling, or a hard stop—when I exceed my plan's automation or API call limits
